text_block_list.text: Yeeeaaah!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Huff, huff...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: So that's how it is...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Хиши Амадзон, Queen of the Amazons,
claims a
stunning victory at the Japan
Cup!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

Whoa, that was an incredible run! It was
so
amazing, it gave me goosebumps.
text_block_list.name: Fan A

text_block_list.text:
Hey, look at Нарита Брайан... Her
expression is
super intense...
text_block_list.name: Fan B

text_block_list.text: I did it, Teach!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, thanks! But man, there's really
only one
opponent for me—
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
We're interrupted before Хиши Амадзон
can finish
her sentence.
Ama.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Hey, Brian! Great timing. I was just
talking about
you!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Today, I brought my A game, and fought
past
some real tough racers. But winning
just didn't
feel like enough.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
It's not the same without you. You're the
only
rival for me.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I'll be waiting for ya, so get on my level
already.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, no need to tell me twice.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
The glint in Нарита Брайан's eyes is as keen
and
fierce as a beast's.

...All this time, I've been chasing my
sister's
shadow. Waking or dreaming, her
back is all I can
see.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
But I've never been able to catch
up—and that
divide between us has
stoked a feverish blaze in
me.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Today... I felt that fire watching you.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
I will definitely surpass you the next time
we
meet. I won't let you win the Arima
Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Oooh! So that's how you feel!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: I knew it!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Next up is finally the Arima Kinen!
